title: Five Business Uses for AI Motion Graphics (creator screen-share)
summary: A ~3 min YouTube-style creator video: a talking-head facecam in a rounded box in the bottom-left over a full-screen recording of X/Twitter posts and a Claude chat, walking through example AI-made motion-graphics videos and business use cases. No motion design of its own; the first 33 s sit on a blurred aurora (teal/cyan) wallpaper with the X window floating, then it goes full-screen browser. Casual, conversational, low production.
fit_reason: Matches Andrew's 'show the screen' teaching format (facecam + screen), but zero motion polish; useful as a structural baseline, not a style reference.

palette.mood: dark, native-UI (X dark mode) with a teal/cyan aurora wallpaper frame in the intro; later light Claude UI (#eef0ed)

typography.display: none added; only native UI type (X Chirp / system sans)
typography.notes: No titles, lower thirds or captions are added in post.

motion: static screen recording with cursor movement and scrolling
occasional zoom on embedded video players
transitions: hard cut between screen sections (only 2 detected cuts)
graphic_elements: blurred aurora gradient wallpaper behind floating window (intro)
ui_treatment: Raw full-screen screen recording of browser/X/Claude; in the intro the window floats on a gradient wallpaper with drop shadow (Screen Studio-style).

sound.voiceover: yes - casual creator talk to camera ('Motion graphics is officially solved, guys...')

signature_moves: facecam bubble bottom-left over screen recording
Screen Studio-style floating window on aurora wallpaper for the intro
showing other people's posts/videos as proof inside the native X UI

best_segments.what: Facecam bubble + floating X window on teal aurora wallpaper while creator talks

recreate.how: Screen Studio / OBS or ffmpeg overlay: screen capture full-frame, rounded facecam composited bottom-left; optional blurred gradient background with padded, shadowed window for intro. Add captions and zooms in post to upgrade it.
recreate.prompt: Creator explainer: full-screen screen recording of a browser with a rounded facecam bubble bottom-left; intro shows the browser window floating with drop shadow on a soft teal aurora gradient.
